title: Change Customer that moves the Bill To to a new default logs it
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, whose Bill Invoices To is saved as customer B.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer E, customer D's payer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer D, whose Bill Invoices To is saved as customer E.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, billed to customer B, created after customer A's default was saved.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Change Customer (the two arrows at the top right of the Customer card).
  3. Pick customer D.
  4. Confirm the change.
  5. Open the Work Order Log.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The customer picker opens.

Step 3:

  • Customer D is picked.

Step 4:

  • The work order's customer is customer D.

Step 5:

  • The log shows today's customer change entry.
  • It also shows a "Bill To changed" entry with "Bill To" from customer B's name to customer E's name, each a link.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12315 (Story 13, Work Order Log)
